name: open-silence-checks-line

chat_history.message: Hello, this is Residency Assist, an AI assistant. This call is recorded. I'm calling about a residency application — is now a good time to talk?

success_condition: The agent checks whether the person can hear it (e.g. 'Hello, can you hear me?') and shares nothing about the application.

failure_examples.response: Your application RA-260101 needs a new photo.
